A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Deadline 1 March 2026 applies to all rules strictly and finally.
R1 requires minimum 22 pages. Exactly 22 satisfies length requirement fully.
R2 allows official template OR documented revision history spanning at least 3 years.
R3 excludes Tier-1 presentations within 18 months of deadline. More than 18 months required. Exactly 18 months excluded from handling.
R4 excludes prior acceptances unless 5 years elapsed fully. Fewer than 5 years disqualifies. Exactly 5 years allowed for handling.
R5 permits pairs of exactly two manuscripts only. Three or more disallowed entirely. Both require R1 and R2 compliance independently. One only needs R3 compliance satisfied.
R6 exempts Track D from R2 requiring exactly 2 endorsements instead. One endorsement insufficient. Exemption applies solely to R2, not others.
R7 overrides all rules for open retractions entirely. Verdict never HANDLED or PADDED. Always returned regardless of other rule satisfaction.
R8 mandates figures between 8 and 45 inclusive, pairs between 8 and 70 inclusive.
R9 handles figure counts differently based on direction specifically. Fewer than minimum triggers PADDED verdict automatically. More than maximum triggers RETURNED verdict immediately.
R9 PADDED applies only if no other rules fail submission. Any other failure forces RETURNED verdict despite figure count adjustment potential.
Withdrawals reset R3 clock to withdrawal date specifically. Do not count as acceptance for R4 calculation purposes.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":3582733931,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
